title: Route Exception Log Form
subtitle: Route Exception: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Route Exception Log Form covers route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan. The dispatch exception coordinator records Route Exception events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Route Exception Log Form keeps Route Exception exceptions visible until the dispatch exception coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Route Exception Log Form at current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point. Document route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan identity before Route Exception begins. Compare route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan findings with stated Route Exception criteria; route unresolved Route Exception issues to transport operations reviewer. For Route Exception Log Form, confirm requirements for Route Exception. Ask transport operations reviewer to review Route Exception conditions beyond the dispatch exception coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Route Exception, identify responsible parties, current safe location, planned route, affected stop, alternate route, and return point, and the linked route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan source.

fields.label: Event time, location, and service commitment

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Route Exception facts for route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Route Exception tracked controls
items: Exception type and immediate safety state

Last completed and next affected stop
Reroute, rescue, transfer, return, or wait option

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Route Exception chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Dispatch Exception Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
blocks.guidance: Pause Route Exception when safe location, driver fitness, vehicle condition, cargo custody, or authorized recovery remains unresolved. Retain the available Route Exception proof and route unresolved route event, vehicle, stop, shipment, delay, safety condition, and recovery plan scope to dispatch exception coordinator.
